ask: You opened me. Most people only do that once. Item 1 is all of them. How do you intend to pay?

replies.say: I'll bring you all of them.
replies.book: Everyone says all. I write down the number later.
A book. You are holding me. We will not be doing this every time.
Noted, in pencil. Item 1 is in ink.

ask: Item {item}. It is warm. They are always warm the first time. How do you feel?

replies.book: That passes. Do not mention it to the others.
They do that. It stops when the page closes.
Now we are talking. Well. I am. You are fetching.

ask: {down} is on the ground. The ground is not in the contract.

replies.book: Apologise to {down}. I only keep the accounts.
Then the plan is also on the ground.
I can write it down. That is not nothing. Ask anyone I have written down.

recall.line: You said that was the plan. I kept the plan. It is on page one, lying down.

ask: Another one down. I am beginning a column for it.

replies.book: Started. It has a heading. The heading is your name.
It is happening again as we speak. Get up.

ask: All of them down, and you awake. That is the wrong way round.

replies.book: Yes. That was never the question.
It was never a question of you. When nobody collects them, they collect people. Go again.
Page one, line one, in red. You were holding me upside down.

ask: A fire. You sit, they lick their wounds, and I watch the dark for you. Do not get used to it.

replies.book: Do not thank the Book. Thanks go in the ledger as a debt.
I was bound four hundred years ago. I am still waiting for my break.

recall.line: You asked what I am. Here is a little more: I am why the dark keeps its distance from this fire.

ask: Tell me something true about yourself. I collect those too.

replies.book: Good. Scared people check the treeline. Brave people become entries.
Then I will be scared for both of us. Someone in this camp should be qualified.
Then I will write down nothing, and underline it.

recall.line: You said the first one looked at you. They all look at you now. Sleep facing the fire.

ask: The line-up is asleep. One of them talks in it. Do you want to know what it says?

replies.book: It says your name, and then a number. I would not worry about the number.
Wise. I will tell you anyway when it matters, which will be the worst possible time.

ask: Where were you, before me?

replies.book: Home is still there. That is what the fetching is for.
Then you lost nothing by coming. Write that on a card and keep it in your shoe.

ask: The end of the trail. {mythic} is ahead, and it has heard about you. Not from me. Mostly.

replies.book: That you are punctual. Be punctual.
Nobody is ready. Ready is a word for forms.
You are home. It simply has a cryptid on the roof.

recall.line: Last trail you said you were ready. I wrote it down. Let us find out if it is still true.

ask: Another trail's end. The air is wrong here. It is wrong on purpose.

replies.book: Then you are learning. Learning is expensive. I am billing it.
It is quiet, which is the noise fine makes just before it isn't.

ask: {mythic} is beaten in {region}. The roads are open. So is a page with its name on it. Fill one or the other.

replies.say: I'll come back and bind it.
replies.book: Then the page waits. Pages are better at waiting than mythics.
Enough is what people say before they turn to page two.
It comes back with friends, and I have to make room. I hate making room.

recall.line: On the first page you said, and I quote, "{said}" Item {item} says otherwise.

ask: Two regions. The ledger is warming up. I am not.

replies.book: Time is the one thing I cannot lend. I have it. I just do not lend it.
Your best is in the ledger. It is a short entry.

recall.line: You said this might not be for you. Three regions on, here you are. I said nothing then. I am saying it now.

ask: Three mythics. Somewhere a door has fewer things behind it. What do you want for that?

replies.book: Then you will get it, on time and in full.
One answer, then. The thumbprint on my pages is not mine. Ask again in a region or two.
You may rest when the ledger closes. The ledger has never closed.

recall.line: {nick}. You asked where the next one was before the first had stopped moving. I liked that. Do not let it get out.
Back in the pines you said binding felt good. Four mythics later, I have stopped asking how you feel.

ask: Four. People will hear of you now. The wrong people, mostly. Are you keeping well?

replies.book: Good. I have written down yes. Do not make me cross it out.
Then we are matched. I have not kept well since the binding. Carry on.

ask: Item {item}. You are getting the hang of this. That is how it starts.

replies.book: The rest of it.

replies.say: I'm only doing what you asked.
replies.book: Everyone is. That is how the rest of it starts, too.

recall.line: In the pines you said the first one looked at you. This one did not. You did not notice. I did.

ask: Item {item}. The ink took it faster than the last. So did you.

replies.book: It is efficient. Nobody has ever asked me to tell the difference.
Then we agree, which should worry one of us.

ask: Item {item}. Did you ever ask where they go when the page closes?

replies.book: Somewhere quieter than here. Not nicer. Quieter.
The first sensible thing anyone has said during a binding.
replies.note: Does not want to know where they go.

recall.line: On the first page you said you would rather not. Item {item}. I have stopped hearing it.
On the first page you said, "{said}" Item {item}. I am still counting.

ask: The ledger is heavier now. I mean that physically. Mind your back.

replies.book: You will. That was never in doubt. The back is.
Nothing put down in me gets up again. That is rather the point.

ask: It tore free. The ink does not miss. That was a choice, and it was not mine.

replies.book: Its. They are allowed to choose. Once.
Wear it lower first. Persuasion is mostly arithmetic.
I will write that it went. I will not write that you let it.

recall.line: Last time you wanted to let one go. I wrote it in the margin. The margin is filling up.

ask: The ink is drying on the page and not on the beast. Again.

replies.book: You are doing it early. Wear it down, then ask.
Everything here is. That is why it needs collecting.

ask: Three tries, nothing. I have seen this before, and I remember how it ended.

replies.book: With me on a shelf, and the beast in a town.
No. Not this time. Again.

ask: Twice in a row. The ledger has a column for this, and you are filling it neatly.

replies.book: Do. Courage is not a line-up.
Every bad run is just a bad run, until it is a short one.
I am a ledger. Counting is the job.

recall.line: You said I did not warn you. Consider yourself warned, in red, the right way up.

ask: Down again. Somewhere a door creaks every time you lose. I can hear it from here.

replies.book: The one they come out of when nobody is collecting.
The door does not grade on effort.

ask: The last stone before {mythic}. You can still turn round. I would not, but you can.

replies.book: I am a book. I would not do anything. That is your department.
We do. I am taking notes on the way.
Turn round twice and you are facing it again. I have saved you the walk.
replies.note: Thought of turning round at the last stone.

recall.line: At your first last stone you thought of turning round. I wrote it down. You did not turn round. I wrote that down too.

ask: Another last stone. They always put the worst at the end. Nobody has ever asked them to stop.

replies.book: The ones who put things at the end.
That is the spirit. It is also the only exit.

ask: I have written you down as {nick}. In pencil, for now. Pencil is a courtesy.

replies.book: Ink is for items. You are staff.
replies.note: Asked to be written in ink.

replies.book: It is. Very little here is fine. Enjoy the one thing.

recall.line: Two regions ago you said you were not scared. I have been scared for both of us since. It is tiring. Take a shift.

ask: The fire is low. Something out there is counting your steps. It keeps losing count. Lucky.

replies.book: Not tonight. It counts worse in the dark.
Bold. I will file that under last words, provisionally.

recall.line: In the pines you said you were at home before me. I checked. It is still there. A light was on.

ask: Ask me something. I am in a mood to answer, which does not happen.

replies.book: Yes.
You picked me up. Most people read the cover first.
Someone who asked the last question too. Go to sleep.

recall.line: Four regions ago you said beating one was enough. The lake disagrees. It has a long memory.

ask: {mythic} goes back under. The lake has kept it a long time. It will keep a grudge longer.

replies.book: Grudges are the lake's business. Items are mine. Come back for it.
Everything in water comes back. That is what water is for.

recall.line: In the pines you said you were scared. Out here there is nowhere to check but the horizon. Check it.

ask: {mythic}, beaten, in a desert that will not remember it happened. I will.

replies.book: Do not. Remembering is not kindness. It is filing.
Because the desert forgets everything eventually, people included. Someone should not.

recall.line: At your first trail's end you asked to go home. You have stopped asking. I noticed. I did not write it down. Some things I keep.

ask: {mythic} is down in the water. The bayou does not take sides. Neither, it turns out, do I.

replies.book: The ledger's. It has never once been on yours, and you are still here.

replies.say: I thought you were on mine.
replies.book: I am on the page. You are on the page. Draw your own conclusions, in pencil.

recall.line: On the first page you asked what I am. You stopped asking somewhere in the mountains. Suspicion is accurate.
You said all of them, on page one. I am still holding you to it. Item {item}.

ask: {mythic}. The last of the trails. The ledger does not close. It changes hands.

replies.book: Look down.
You are done with the trails. That is a different thing, and you will find out how different.
replies.note: Said they were done, in the Ozarks.
